nuggets.text: Tevin Carter threw for 309 yards and ran for 130 more in the first-ever Chancellor's Cup game at Tarleton State.
Tevin Carter threw four touchdown passes without an interception as the Panthers beat Texas Southern 52-14.
Malachi Williams had three sacks in the Panthers' 52-14 win over Texas Southern.
The Panthers scored 28 points in the third quarter alone against Texas Southern.
The Panthers won the 2025 SWAC title, their first conference crown since 2009, edging Jackson State 23-21.
In 2025 the Panthers became the first team from west of Louisiana to play in the Celebration Bowl.
Before Prairie View, coach Tremaine Jackson became Valdosta State's first Black head football coach in 2022.
Hall of Famer Ken Houston briefly played center at Prairie View before becoming a star linebacker.
Prairie View's Charlie "Choo Choo" Brackins was the first HBCU alumnus to play quarterback in the NFL.
Panthers coach Tremaine Jackson played college football as a defensive tackle at Texas Southern and Louisiana-Monroe.
